pathway.title: Historical ARCC — March/July2029 comparison
pathway.question: What does the normalized historical pair comparison establish?

blocks.title: Historical compensation comparison and decision limits

runs.text: Historical pair: March1 2029 US04010LBF94 versus July15 2029 US04010LBG77, atDec31 2024; parent unsecured/USD; Same issuer is useful comparative control; different maturities, call terms, indenture bases and missing execution evidence remain

Assume both clean: July extra maturity yield2.210154bp; simple Treasury residual difference0.160839bp; display-sensitivity yield interval−0.616287 to5.036816bp; Point yield advantage exists, but supported precision/tenor comparison cannot establish a robust preference

Assume both dirty: July extra maturity yield18.522010bp; simple residual difference16.472695bp; display-sensitivity yield interval15.614840 to21.429430bp; Concrete contrary evidence for July, conditional on unverified consistent basis; not automatic fair/cheap or implementable preference

Duration trade-off: March conditional duration3.591090/3.576032years; July3.836448/3.813151years, clean/dirty respectively; Shorter March exposure is real in the stated model; it is not evidence that both securities have equal risk-adjusted compensation

Decision / next action: Both Requires More Work; RV Unclear; first priority actual basis, unrounded simultaneous levels and executable depth; Retain both countercases; no weighted score, current trade, new size or mandate headroom
